drafted_from: workflow:post-a-weekly-build-in-public-update's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its job, input schema and the step named in the worked example)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:post-a-weekly-build-in-public-update from my tasks and sales records, for X and LinkedIn, never naming customers."
no_lists_because: It reads the person's own records named in its input and keeps one post-a-weekly-build-in-public record of its own, so it ships no list.
instructions: 1. Name the record kinds or lists that show your work in lists (for example "tasks" and "sales"), the platforms you post on, your word rules and the words you never share (private).

2. Say "Run workflow:post-a-weekly-build-in-public-update" with them. It reads what changed in the last 7 days (read-week) and picks up to 3 numbers that moved, one real setback and whether last week's promise was kept (pick).
3. It reads your last 5 posts on each platform to match length and opening, writes one draft per platform (draft) and checks every word against your rules (check-words).
4. Approve each draft exactly as written (approve-and-post), post it yourself, and it keeps the week and next week's promise as a record (record).

worked_examples.title: Pick the numbers that moved and the real setback
worked_examples.ask: Run workflow:post-a-weekly-build-in-public-update for my tasks and sales, on X and LinkedIn.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json, step pick: from the read-week changes it picks up to 3 numbers each with what, before, now and record_id, exactly one real setback, and promise_kept. Say read-week found sales going from 12 to 19 (record sales:week-46), sign-ups from 40 to 52 (record signups:week-46) and a task "ship the reminder email" that slipped (record task:reminder-email), with last week's promise "ship the reminder email" not done.
